# Else <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

```blitzbasic
If condition Then statement Else statement
Else
```

## Description

The part of an [If](If) that runs when the condition, and every [ElseIf](ElseIf) condition before it, is false. In the block form it stands on a line of its own.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
For n = 1 To 3
	If n = 2
		Print "two"
	Else
		Print "not two"
	EndIf
Next
```

```text
not two
two
not two
```
